title: Engineering memory policy
description: The rules the memory is read under. Only keys the tooling actually consumes may appear: additionalProperties is false, so a setting that no code reads cannot be declared here and then quietly ignored, which is finding CP9-F-005. The guardrail registry path is fixed in lessons.guardrail_registry_path and is deliberately not configurable. Version 2.1.0 adds the rule that a lesson's prose may not contradict its status; a memory declaring an earlier version is read under the rules it declares. Version 2.2.0 adds that every guardrail registry entry resolves its own kind and reference.
